In current LlamaIndex (the `llama_index.core` package, v0.10 and later), you set global defaults on the `Settings` singleton:

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.openai import OpenAI
from llama_index.embeddings.openai import OpenAIEmbedding

Settings.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4o-mini", temperature=0.1)
Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small")
```

Set this once at application startup, before you build indexes or create query engines. Any index, query engine, or retriever created afterward uses these defaults unless you pass its own `llm=` or `embed_model=` argument, which overrides the global setting for that object.

The integrations are separate pip packages, so install the ones you need, for example:

```
pip install llama-index-llms-openai llama-index-embeddings-openai
```

For other providers, swap in the matching integration. For a local Ollama setup:

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_index.embeddings.ollama import OllamaEmbedding

Settings.llm = Ollama(model="llama3.1", request_timeout=120.0)
Settings.embed_model = OllamaEmbedding(model_name="nomic-embed-text")
```

On Windows PowerShell, you can set an API key for the current session with `$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = "your-key"`.

Other global settings on `Settings` include `chunk_size`, `chunk_overlap`, `node_parser`, `tokenizer`, `callback_manager`, and `context_window`/`num_output`.

I can't see your project files, so I can't confirm how your code is set up. Also, my knowledge of LlamaIndex's latest releases may be incomplete, so check the current docs if a class path or default model doesn't match what you have installed.
